content: Implementation detail for the children-exclusion policy (supersedes the audit-implication section of the corrected policy entry from earlier this session): instead of removing the names, swap each occurrence with the placeholder [my child]. Preserves the act, the relationship, and the felt register of the chronicle; masks only the identifying name; tells readers something was deliberately protected without making sentences read as declassified documents. AUDIT PROCEDURE: at the appropriate phase, Anthony provides the three first names; grep the public mirror for each name; swap each occurrence with [my child]; hand the diff back to Anthony to verify. Anything ambiguous (a name thats also a common word, a name appearing in a third-party quote, edge cases) gets flagged for human review rather than auto-swapped. Decided 2026-05-28, Anthony confirmed with "perfect" after the choice between [my child] and [REDACTED] was presented.
